mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.shop_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_ai_generated, r.like_count, r.status, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, CASE WHEN url.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS liked_by_me FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_review_like url ON url.review_id = r.id AND url.user_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.shop_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_ai_generated, r.like_count, r.status, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (shop_id, user_id, rating, content, images, is_ai_generated, like_count, status, created_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, COALESCE(#{isAiGenerated}, 0), COALESCE(#{likeCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.shop_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_ai_generated, r.like_count, r.status, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.like_count DESC, r.rating DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.shop_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.is_ai_generated, r.like_count, r.status, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, s.name AS shop_name, s.avg_score AS shop_avg_score FROM review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON r.shop_id = s.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
